svg.text: Two phase transitions in a system of coupled oscillators
Each disc is an oscillator; its colour and hand show its phase. Grey arcs are couplings — the deeper an arc bows inward, the longer the range of that link.
The point: a short line of metronomes will synchronise. Extend it to ten thousand and it never does. Now start adding connections and you
cross two thresholds: first into competing clusters of coherence, then into global coherence. We may be finely tuned to sit at the edge
between them — which is what lets attention toggle: jhāna raises the coherence of the sensory fields, and the attentional system pivots off
that coherence to collapse into a single stream. 5-MeO-DMT pushes the system towards the right-hand panel; DMT towards the middle one.
Raising the coherence of the networks a system talks to is functionally equivalent to adding connections inside that system.
